experiment: Cognee on Unsloth Inkling Mini with DSpark draft three
scope: Separate from AtlasKV and synthetic decode probes.

quality.rubric: Frozen gold spans; q37 excluded as predeclared. Q38 scores trigger and round, without treating the worm as an ally.

source_review.reviewer: Codex post-run source review; not blinded human adjudication
source_review.outcome: Incomplete transition answer with supported broad structure
source_review.comparison_to_native_inkling: The native schema-guided run recovered the actual Chapter 4 ending and return hook; this run did not.
source_review.interpretation: Generated thinking was removed, but the agent repeatedly reformulated near-identical transition queries and ended with less relevant evidence. Runtime, quantization and generation policy all differ, so the quality change is not isolated to thinking.

limits: Single pass of factual questions and one agent run; no repeated-run confidence intervals.
Graph and summaries were ingested by Qwen; this tests generation and retrieval, not ingestion.
Runtime, quantization, prompt caching, device load and dates differ from historical baselines.
After an unbounded stall, factual readers received a new 4096-token cap; capped generations count as failures.
Thinking-channel generation is blocked by a model-specific logit ban; this differs from historical native reasoning.
Source review is Codex assessment, not blinded human adjudication.
Client worker memory was bounded to 12 GiB; Clef shared Spark 2.
